units.source_text: 明石姬看见源氏公子许久不来，认为果然不出所料，便觉十分悲伤，现在真恨不得投海了事。

en.t: When the Lady of Akashi saw that Prince Genji had not come for so long, she thought it was just as she had expected, and felt terribly sad; now she almost wished she could throw herself into the sea and end it all.

units.source_text: 以前单靠残年的父母照拂，不知何时始能像别人一样享受幸福。

en.t: Until then she had depended only on the care of her aged parents, never knowing when she might enjoy happiness like other people.

units.source_text: 但在这春花秋月等闲度的期间，倒也并不感到何等痛苦。

en.t: Yet while she idly passed the days among spring blossoms and autumn moons, she had not felt any great suffering.

units.source_text: 当时虽然也曾推想恋爱结婚生活难免种种忧恼，但料不到如此之可悲。

en.t: Even then she had imagined that love and marriage would inevitably bring many sorrows, but she had never expected it to be this painful.

units.source_text: 然而她在源氏公子面前，并不泄露苦情，依旧和颜悦色。

en.t: Still, in Prince Genji's presence she did not reveal her distress, and remained as gentle and pleasant as ever.

units.source_text: 源氏公子与明石姬相处日久，爱情日深。

en.t: As Prince Genji spent more time with the Lady of Akashi, his love for her grew deeper day by day.

units.source_text: 然而想起家中紫姬独守空床，为丈夫薄情而伤心，便觉十分抱歉。

en.t: Yet when he thought of Lady Murasaki at home, alone in an empty bed and grieving over her husband's coldness, he felt deeply sorry.
For that reason, there were many nights when he slept alone.
